top_signals.title: Bloomberg Brief 10/23/2026
top_signals.summary: Declines in yields ease after a selloff in tech stocks drove investors to Treasuries. Oil heads for a third consecutive weekly gain as escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia stoke supply concerns. Shares of tower companies rise and wireless carriers decline in pre-market trading as SpaceX is said to be seeking access to 80,000 cell sites across the US for new networks. Laura Cooper of Nuveen joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss structural challenges facing the equity market.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows as $636 million in withdrawals erase previous day’s inflows
top_signals.summary: BlackRock's IBIT led Thursday's net outflows with $254.1 million, while four other funds also witnessed withdrawals.
